claim.claim-text: 1. A bow ramp arrangement (4) for a ship (1) comprising a bow ramp (8) and a wire actuation system (50), wherein the bow ramp (8) comprises a first bow ramp part (9) and a second bow ramp part (10), wherein the first bow ramp part (9) is arranged to be pivotably connected to a ship (1), the first bow ramp part (9) further being separably engageable to or fixedly engaged to the second bow ramp part (10) and pivotable relative to the second bow ramp part (10) when engaged to the second bow ramp part (10), wherein the wire actuation system (50) comprises at least one wire (51) and a wire actuator (52), wherein the wire actuator (52) e.g. is one of an electrically powered winch, a hydraulically powered winch or a hydraulic cylinder attached to a block and tackle/jigger winch,
characterized inthat the wire (51) is connected to the wire actuator (52), to the second bow ramp part (10) and to a wire actuation point (53) adapted to be arranged in a ship (1),

that the first bow ramp part (9) is connected to a first bow ramp actuator (47) wherein the wire actuator (52) is arranged to control the deployment of the bow ramp (8) together with the first bow ramp actuator (47).

2. The bow ramp arrangement (4) according to claim 1, wherein the bow ramp (8) further comprises a third bow ramp part (10), wherein the second bow ramp part (10) is pivotably connected to the third bow ramp part (10), and the second and third bow ramp parts (10, 11) are connected to each other by a second bow ramp actuator, wherein the wire actuator (52) is arranged to control the deployment of the bow ramp (8) together with the first bow ramp actuator (47) and the second bow ramp actuator.
3. The bow ramp arrangement (4) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the wire actuation system (50) comprises a wire attachment point (54) arranged on the second bow ramp part (10).

4. The bow ramp arrangement (4) according to claim 3, wherein the wire actuation point (53) is movable and adapted to be arranged above the wire attachment point (54), when the bow ramp (8) is deployed.
5. The bow ramp arrangement (4) according to any one of claims 1-4, wherein the wire actuator (52) is located either in a ship (1) to which the ramp is attached or in the second bow ramp part (10).
6. The bow ramp arrangement (4) according to any one of claims 2-5, wherein the second bow ramp part (10) and the third bow ramp part (11) have essentially the same length.

7. The bow ramp arrangement (4) according to any one of claims 1-6, wherein the wire (51) is arranged to be pre-tensioned in order to absorb loads acting on the bow ramp (8) and quay, dock, link span or pontoon when loading/unloading cargo.

8. The bow ramp arrangement (4) according to any one of claims 1-7, wherein the second bow ramp part (10) further comprises ramp guides (56) arranged to interact with a ramp guide arrangement (55) arranged to be attached to the ship (1).

9. A method for deployment of a bow ramp (8) on a ship (1), wherein a bow ramp arrangement (4) comprises a bow ramp (8) and a wire actuation system (50), wherein the bow ramp (8) comprises a first bow ramp part (9), a second bow ramp part (10), wherein the first bow ramp part (9) is arranged to be pivotably connected to a ship (1), the first bow ramp part (9) further being separably engageable to or fixedly engaged to the second bow ramp part (10) and pivotable relative to the second bow ramp part (10) when engaged to the second bow ramp part (10), wherein the wire actuation system (50) comprises at least one wire (51) and a wire actuator (52), characterized in that the wire (51) is connected to the wire actuator (52), to the second bow ramp part (10) and to a wire actuation point (53) adapted to be arranged in a ship (1), that the first bow ramp part (9) is connected to a first bow ramp actuator (47), wherein the method comprises:

- operating the first bow ramp actuator (47) to lower the first bow ramp part (9) to engage with the second bow ramp part (10), - operating the first bow ramp actuator further (47) and adjusting the length of the wire (51) to deploy the second bow ramp part (10), - extending the first bow ramp actuator (47) and deploying the wire (51) to lower the engaged first and second bow ramp parts (9, 10), thereby deploying the bow ramp (8).

10. The method according to claim 9, wherein the bow ramp (8) further comprises a third bow ramp part (10), wherein the second bow ramp part (10) is pivotably connected to a third bow ramp part (10) and the second and third bow ramp parts (10, 11) are connected to each other by a second bow ramp actuator, wherein the method further comprises:

- operating the first bow ramp actuator (47) and adjusting the length of the wire (51) in order to bring the second bow ramp part to a forward and upwards tilted position in which the third bow ramp part (11) can be rotated without interfering with the bow door supports (49), - operating the second bow ramp actuator such that the third bow ramp part (11) is extended, thereby deploying the bow ramp (8).
11. The method according to claim 9 or 10, wherein the method further comprises:

- moving the wire actuation point (53) relative a wire attachment point (54) on the second bow ramp part (10) to a position where the wire actuation point (53) and the wire attachment point (54) lie essentially in the same vertical plane, when the bow ramp (8) is deployed.
12. Method according to any one of claims 10 or 11, wherein the method further comprises: after the first bow ramp part (9) and second bow ramp part (10) are engaged,

- guiding the second bow ramp part (10) on a ramp guide arrangement (55) arranged to be attached to the ship (1), by means of ramp guides (56) arranged to be attached to the second bow ramp part (10), - extending the second bow ramp actuator such that the third bow ramp part (10) is extended, wherein the second bow ramp actuator is extended after the length of the wire (51) is adjusted but before the ramp guides (56) leaves the ramp guide arrangement (55).
13. Method according to any one of claims 9-12 wherein the method further comprises:
- pre-tensioning the wire (51) after deployment of the bow ramp (8).
14. A ship (1) comprising a bow ramp arrangement (4) according to any one of claims 1-8.

15. The ship (1) according to claim 14, wherein the wire actuation point (53) is movable relative the wire attachment point (54) to a position where the wire actuation point (53) and the wire attachment point (54) lie essentially in the same vertical plane, when the bow ramp (8) is deployed.
16. The ship (1) according to claim 14 or 15, wherein the ship (1) comprises a bow space (7) in which the entire bow ramp (8) fits when the bow ramp (8) is stowed.
17. A system for a ship (1) comprising a bow door arrangement (3) and a bow ramp arrangement (4),

wherein the bow door arrangement (3) comprises a starboard bow door (5), a port bow door (6), first starboard and port guiding arrangements (19, 21) and second starboard and port guiding arrangements (20, 22), each of the first and second starboard and port guiding arrangements (19, 21; 20, 22) comprising a ship guide part (19a, 21a; 20a ,22a) arranged to be attached to a ship (1) and a bow door guide part (19b, 21b; 20b, 22b) arranged to be attached to a bow door (5, 6), where the ship guide parts (19a, 21a; 20a ,22a) and bow door guide parts (19b, 21b; 20b ,22b) are arranged to interact to guide the starboard and port bow doors (5, 6) between an open position and a closed position, where the first starboard bow door guide part (19b) of the first starboard guiding arrangement (19) is arranged on a starboard bow door top part (18) of the starboard bow door (5) and that the second starboard bow door guide part (21b) of the second starboard guiding arrangement (21) is arranged on a starboard bow door bottom part (23) of the starboard bow door (5), and in that the first port bow door guide part (20b) of the first port guiding arrangement (20) is arranged on a port bow door top part (24) of the port bow door (6) and that the second port bow door guide part (22b) of the second port guiding arrangement (22) is arranged on a port bow door bottom part (25) of the port bow door (6), and wherein the bow ramp arrangement (4) comprises a bow ramp (8) and a wire actuation system (50), wherein the bow ramp (8) comprises a first bow ramp part (9) and a second bow ramp part (10), wherein the first bow ramp part (9) is arranged to be pivotably connected to a ship (1), the first bow ramp part (9) further being separably engageable to or fixedly engaged to the second bow ramp part (10) and pivotable relative to the second bow ramp part (10) when engaged to the second bow ramp part (10), wherein the wire actuation system (50) comprises at least one wire (51) and a wire actuator (52), wherein the wire actuator (52) e.g. is one of an electrically powered winch, a hydraulically powered winch or a hydraulic cylinder attached to a block and tackle/jigger winch, where the wire (51) is connected to the wire actuator (52), to the second bow ramp part (10) and to a wire actuation point (53) adapted to be arranged in a ship (1), and the first bow ramp part (9) is connected to a first bow ramp actuator (47), wherein the wire actuator (52) is arranged to control the deployment of the bow ramp (8) together with the first bow ramp actuator (47).
